notes.title: Patch 1.01 - Added change of view. From now switch view is possible, to show how battleships fly into space.
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29777290/ba35f53a216124d0419662e53090659b501d6beb.png

1. Added change of view. From now switch view is possible, to show how battleships fly into space.
2. AI adjusts to player startegy, through that gameplay is more interesting than before.
3. Patch 1.01 - first actualizations
4. Tutorials pictures are visible longer, because a lot of players scroll this and then finally have no idea how to play.
5. added a new locations
